questions.prompt: Why does a tokenizer cut a rare word such as "unbelievable" into several tokens?
options: Rare words are not allowed in a request
The model can only read one letter at a time
Its box of known pieces has no single piece for the rare word, so it uses smaller known pieces
Each token can hold at most four characters
questions.explanation: Common words have their own token, but a rare word is built from smaller known pieces. This lets the model read and write any text, including words it never saw whole.

questions.prompt: With the estimate of 4 characters per token, about how many tokens is a 2,000-character file?
questions.explanation: 2,000 characters divided by 4 characters per token gives 500 tokens. It is an estimate, because the real tokenizer can cut the text differently.

questions.prompt: A reply reports input_tokens 12 and output_tokens 30. What do the numbers count?
options: 12 tokens in the request you sent, and 30 tokens in the text the model wrote
12 words and 30 letters in the reply
12 seconds to send and 30 seconds to reply
questions.explanation: A hosted model counts the request and the reply in tokens. Input is what you sent and output is what the model wrote, and both are charged.
